title: Defy Advanced SL 1 (2026)
notes: Official 2026 UK exact-trim page supports the Advanced SL composite frame and fork, SRAM Force AXS E1 2x12 build, SLR 0 40 carbon wheels, 700x32C CADEX tires, 40 mm maximum tire size, fender mounts, sizes and geometry.
